```{r}
library(ISLR2)
data(College)
str(College)
```

```{r}
summary(College)
```

```{r}
contrast(College$Private)
```

```{r}
pairs(College[, 2:9])
```

```{r}
library(psych)
cor.plot(College[, 2:18])
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
boxplot(Outstate ~ Private, data=College)
boxplot(F.Undergrad ~ Private, data=College)
boxplot(Top10perc ~ Private, data=College)
```

```{r}
model_log1 <- glm(Private ~ Outstate + F.Undergrad + Room.Board + Top10perc,
                  data = College, family=binomial)
summary(model_log1)
```

```{r}
model_log2 <- glm(Private ~ Outstate + F.Undergrad, data=College, family = binomial)
summary(model_log2)
```

```{r}
model_log3 <- glm(Private ~ Outstate + F.Undergrad + S.F.Ration + perc.alumni, family =binomial, data=College)
sumamry(model_log3)
```

```{r}
exp(coef(model_log3))
```
